LESSON: SIGN READING 2.2.2 COMPREHENSION

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade two
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.2: Sign Reading 2.2.2 Comprehension
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign Reading 2.2.2 Comprehension, part of Strand 2 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade two ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: Why do we listen to and observe signed stories? 2. How do we answer question from a text?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign Reading 2.2.2 Comprehension together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and collaboration: speaking or signing skills as learners reason and argue out their points during group discussions.

Digital literacy: Skill of interaction with digital devices as learners sign read simple digital texts related to the theme.

Values:
Unity: Cooperation as the learner collaborates with others in group activities.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life Skills: Effective communication as learners sign reading abilities improve.

Link to other Learning Areas:

29

Mathematical Activities and Kenyan Sign Language Activities: Comprehension is necessary in all these learning areas.
